walk.answer: In-chunk surface: profile template (settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md, audience casual, German directive body), install.sh opt-in copy to ~/.claude/context/global, nightly/bootstrap consolidate `language <lang>` threading. Items 1-5 hold for the scripts chunk; items 6-8 are UI (other chunk). The install-order gap (profile copied after sync_skills) is already a known finding.

Scripts-side stories (14 nightly German/jargon-free via consolidate language arg, 16 profile set at install, switch back to developer flips skill overrides) hold; UI stories 9-13, 15 are other chunks.

17: template front matter language de + audience casual, glossary, never-translate list, Technisches Detail label present. 25/26: nightly run.sh reads language via sed, consolidate prompt gets `language <lang>` only when set and not en. 18-24 are hooks/Go/templates outside this chunk (global-context.sh not in chunk).

27: install.sh copies presentation-profile.${SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE}.md with mkdir -p only when set. 28: smine.iss TInputOptionWizardPage after RepoPage, default English/developer checked, ProfileArg appends ` -presentation-profile=de`; install.ps1 has -PresentationProfile (its two-word forwarding is a known finding). 29/30 are Go/CLAUDE.md outside chunk.
All items are templates/Go/skill prose; no scripts-chunk file implements them. Nothing in the chunk contradicts them (nightly passes language to consolidate).

41: sync_hooks.sh `read -r answer || answer=n` present. 43: sync_skills.sh casual branch merges per-leaf off into settings.json preserving foreign keys, writes overlay with on, merges overlay into repo .claude/settings.local.json; developer branch drops leaf overrides and deletes overlay. 44: nightly copies overlay into worktree .claude/settings.local.json, .gitignore covers it, no --settings injection. 42, 45-48 are Go. Item 50's casual auto-apply default defeated by the plist's SMINE_AUTO_APPLY=never is already a known finding.

50: audience parsed above stage 1, ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE defaults on for casual (plist auto-apply override known). 51: stage 3 gated on exit+publish 0, runs from repo_root with manifest tools, --effort medium, dirty check 70, prune-or-log, report removed, status propagated; the untracked .orchestrate-report tripping the dirty check is a known finding; the wrapper-side additionalDirectories reconcile and its erasure are known. 49, 52-54 are skill/Go.

64: acdsl-policy-guard.sh is fail-open without jq, walks up from cwd to acdsl/policy.json, denies the five self-management files in gated/strict and *.acdsl|acdsl/* in strict with the worktree-write-guard deny JSON shape, passes paths outside the policy repo; registered in settings.json PreToolUse Write|Edit|NotebookEdit after worktree-write-guard, timeout 10. Path-normalization bypass and the removed permissions.ask rules are known findings. 55-63 are acdsl Go.

65's 'read-gate.sh stays unchanged' was the spec-7 change's scope boundary; read-gate.sh was later changed by an unlisted change (subagents owe spills of skills they invoked) — spill naming matches skill-context.sh ($session_id/$skill.md). Not counted as a spec-7 FAIL; noted for the station. 66-72 are railroad-review skill/runbooks outside chunk.

76: nightly run.sh compares casual for orchestrate/auto-apply/dev-mode defaults; de template writes audience: casual with 'casual user' prose; installer label '(German, casual)'; the leftover 'Non-developer' comment in nightly run.sh is known. 77: sync_skills migrates non-developer -> casual in place via tmp+mv before reading audience, other values untouched, overrides applied for casual. 73-75, 78-82 are templates/skills.
83-87 are Go sessions store/routes/templates; no scripts-chunk implementation.

88: cmd/bootstrap/run.sh exports MSYS vars, sources platform.sh/skill.sh, exits 64 off main or dirty, warns on missing jq/shellcheck, non-dry requires non-empty BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE (78) and exports the token. 89: profile language/audience/dev-mode via sed, dev mode from SMINE_DEV_MODE or dev-mode: true, forced off for casual; overlay copy (its overwrite of operator keys is known); --repos from additionalDirectories git dirs. 90: stage prompts match (smine-style $n, --since vs --last, --dev, --repos, --agents, extra prompt, consolidate language, apply with cap/decide/rules-file and votes file created first, orchestrate bootstrap + since). 91: routine_run_claude with manifest tools (warn when empty), --add-dir global, model/effort/permission/budget/json, envelope appended, failures continue, orchestrate last, DRY lines. 92: dirty tree -> 70 with report tail, else report removed, completion printed, first non-zero stage status. 93-95 are Go/skills.

99: nightly run.sh initializes profile_dev_mode empty, honors SMINE_DEV_MODE, forces off for casual, appends --dev. 103: install.sh warns on missing jq/shellcheck with brew hint; install.ps1 making shellcheck fatal is a known finding. 96-98, 100-102 are Go/skills.
All items concern context rules, planformat verifier, fdesign/fmt skills and plan files; nothing in the scripts chunk.

114: squash_contained (merge-tree --write-tree exit 0 and first-line tree equals candidate^{tree}) and hash_explained_anywhere over explained_pairs, bash-3.2 safe. 115: layer 4 runs after the per-commit loop only for candidates with non-empty cherry_plus not fully explained, marks remaining '+' commits explained; UNPICKED recount moves explained-anywhere unpicked/notwin to squashed:n; summary gains squashed; IN stars from candidate_fully_explained; layers 1-3 and remove-script dirty/untracked checks unchanged; an edited squash leaves the merged tree different, stays unpicked. Cross-branch memo in remove_agent_worktrees checked: a descendant branch with an extra unmerged commit stays unsafe. 116: remote-FROM upgrade accepts squash_contained "$from" (unreachable when from is empty: evaluate_branch returns at the from check); remove script inherits via evaluate_branch. 117: cache key salted |v2, header documents the layer and squashed:n, detail mode annotates both unpicked arms. Tooltip and 118-122 are Go/templates.

123-132 are smine-style skill and Go/profile page; scripts-chunk files only consume style-profile via the bootstrap smine-style stage (--add-dir global), consistent with 127 (install/sync never write style-profile.md: install.sh and sync scripts do not).

137: install.sh captures env first, sources install.env, resolves env > file > defaults 6001/4242/42442, writes values back (home overrides written as PEEK_CLAUDE_HOME/PEEK_CODEX_HOME rather than the spec's CLAUDE_HOME/CODEX_HOME — consistent across install.sh, README and the plist expansion, no functional effect), pins peek-mcp@v1.2.2, kills same-user listeners on both peek ports before launchctl bootstrap. 138: __PEEK_PORT__/__PEEK_CONTROL_PORT__/__PEEK_HOME_ARGS__ expanded, home args only when set. 139: settings.json endpoint uses {{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}}; sync_settings.sh sources install.env (default 42442) and expands in both sed sites. 141: .gitignore adds /install.env. Unquoted home values are a known finding. 133-136, 140 are peek/Go.
142-148 are Go registry/status cache. 149 ('no status-script or remove-script changes') concerns that change; the status/remove script edits in this range trace to spec-11, not spec-14.

notes: All 28 manifest files read in full; no partners. Every defect drafted in this chunk matched a known-ledger row by file and substance and was suppressed: bootstrap overlay cp over operator keys (cmd/bootstrap/run.sh:74), plist SMINE_AUTO_APPLY=never defeating the casual decide default (routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:45), untracked .orchestrate-report tripping the stage-3 clean check (run.sh:328), install.ps1 fatal shellcheck (install.ps1:20), skill-eval quality-context/brief paths absent in every ref (plist:27), README documenting the deleted skill-eval-fexplore routine (routines/README.md:18), profile installed after sync_skills on fresh casual installs (install_windows.go:105 row covers install.sh too). Changes in this chunk that trace to no listed spec (not raised as findings, flagged for the station): cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh and its PreToolUse registration, read-gate.sh subagent spill requirement (spec-7 item 65 said read-gate.sh stays unchanged), print_agent_worktrees_status.sh verdict cache, .serena/.DS_Store untracked filter, worktree.sh merge-resolve prompt + HEAD check, SMINE_SUBAGENTS, skill-eval fexplore defaults, peek v1.2.2 CI pin, Makefile build-install. Cross-chunk (unverified here): internal/routines consumes routines/skill-eval/default-disabled; internal/server/routines.go Configure default SMINE_AUTO_APPLY=never interacts with the known nightly auto-apply finding; Go install_windows.go writes install.env keys without PEEK_*_HOME.
